record.oneLiner: GTM infrastructure platform for pulling in data, running AI agent workflows, and launching sales and marketing plays.
record.verdictReason: Public API uses a clay-api-key header and keys are created self-serve via the clay CLI, but the only access route found is a 14-day Pro trial of a paid product and the docs do not state the plan needed for the API. Unverified: a web search names an official Clay MCP (developers.clay.com/concepts/mcp, run as clay mcp), but both Clay MCP pages returned 404 to WebFetch, so existingMcp is recorded as none pending re-check.

evidence.quote: Every request to the Clay Public API must include a Clay API key in the `clay-api-key` header.
14-day Pro trial, no credit card required
It says you can call the Clay API from your own applications.
It requires a coding-agent host with a shell — Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor
